summary: Master evidence-based DEI strategies for financial institutions. Align with ISO 30415 and ESG standards to drive institutional growth. Enroll today.
lede: Finance diversity and inclusion training helps financial-services professionals translate equity goals into practical organizational practices. It is for people, risk, compliance, investment and banking professionals who need to assess inclusion and strengthen accountability across financial institutions. Participants practice analyzing workforce and pay data, identifying bias in hiring and financial technology, and developing inclusive products and measurable DEI strategies.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for professionals responsible for shaping culture, managing risk, and driving talent strategy within the global financial ecosystem.
modules: Inclusive Product Design and Customer Engagement
Stakeholder Management and Supply Chain Diversity
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3-5 years of experience in a management, HR, compliance, or risk-related role within a financial institution. Familiarity with basic organizational reporting and talent management processes is recommended.
